messages:
Sam: Heads-up 16 - next Wednesdays livestream is locked. Need a concise runbook for: reg-page gating, zoom capture settings, post-event fileflow, and clip delivery SLAs. Target: gated replay + 10 social clips + SRTs delivered to CDN within 48h. Owners: Maria (registration + emails), Lee (Zoom + record settings), Jordan (S3 pipeline + transcode), Olivia (clips + social), Design-Team (hero/thumbs).

Maria: On reg gating: prefer email + company only on replay capture for 14 days, then public. Consent checkbox required (marketing). HubSpot list = webinar_may_live_reg. Zap: form -> HS list + tag `webinar_may_live_replay`. Agree?

Lee: Zoom checklist:
- Enable Cloud Recording (separate video/audio tracks)
- Turn on Auto-Transcription (English)
- Host local backup recording as fallback
- Record shared screen + active speaker separate
Config snippet for host account:
```
Cloud Recording: enabled
Audio Transcript: enabled
Record separate files for each participant: enabled
```
Schedule a 20-min tech run the day before at 10:30am.

Jordan: Fileflow I'll implement:
1) Zoom cloud -> downloader picks up to s3://redwood-prod/webinars/may_live/{event_id}/raw/
2) Transcode + -3LUFS normalization -> s3://.../deliverables/
3) Extract transcript -> clean -> write SRT (EN) + run translate job -> SRT-ES, SRT-FR
4) Auto-split into clips using chapter JSON -> s3://.../clips/
Naming convention: webinar_may2026_{eventid}_{clip_key}_v1.mp4

Olivia: Clip plan:
- 10 clips: 7 x 30s product/bench highlights, 3 x 60s thought-leader snippets
- Social-ready: burned captions, -3LUFS loudness, 9:16 + 16:9 exports
- Thumbnail variants: 3 templates, swap hero image + short CTA
Timeline: edits day0-1, QA day2, gated publish within 48h. Tag any rework `needs-edit` in Airtable.

Sam: Maria - can reg modal accept email+company only and immediately reveal embed player after submit? We want minimal friction.

Maria: Yes. One-step gate. Include a privacy blurb and consent checkbox. We'll set lifecycle stage to `lead` in HS. Also add a small nudge copy: "Get the replay + resource pack".

Lee: Caption plan note: Zoom auto-transcript EN, then pipeline will translate to ES/FR. Translation adds cost; approved for EMEA reach. Also enable separate audio track recording for easier post-edit.

Jordan: FFmpeg split example for the clip job:
```
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -ss 00:14:10 -to 00:14:40 -c copy clip_05.mp4
```
I'll produce chapter JSON with timestamps and run batch splits. Pipeline will also burn-in captions for social exports.

Design-Team: I'll upload 3 hero options by EOD: speaker close-up, product demo still, and a benchmark stat card. Provide copy options for CTAs ("Try Redwood", "See benchmarks", "Get the dataset").

Olivia: Thumbnails & CTAs - I'll use templates and swap in hero images + 1-line CTA. UTM pattern: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=may_live&utm_content={clip}. Please confirm.

ReplayBot: Recording available: s3://redwood-prod/webinars/may_live/1754321987/raw/ZoomCloud_1754321987.mp4 \u2705

Jordan: Pipeline picked it up and started transcode + SRT extraction. ETA ~35 minutes.

Maria: Draft email cadence (short): Day0: Thanks + gated replay; Day3: highlight clip + trial CTA; Day8: benchmark case study + demo invite; Day14: replay public + last nudge. I'll drop the copy in the campaign doc.

Lee: Compliance/retention: raw/ -> coldstorage after 90 days; deliverables/ retained 24 months. Log KMS key and retention policy in the bucket metadata. Also ensure access limited to integrator role.

Olivia: QA checklist for clips: caption sync, audio drift, proper loudness, brand safe, watermark presence. If fail, mark `needs-edit` and route to Jordan's queue.

Sam: Recap: Event Wed -> tech run Tues 10:30 -> auto-upload -> pipeline ~35-45m -> deliverables by EOD -> clip sprint next day -> gated assets live within 48h. Any blockers?

Maria: Need final privacy blurb and consent copy for the registration modal. I'll draft and share.

Jordan: Adding S3 lifecycle rule to move `raw/` prefix to Glacier after 90d and set IAM perms for `pipeline-integrator` role.

Lee: I'll run host test tomorrow 10:30am - please join to verify separate tracks and transcript capture.

Sam: Great. If no other blocks, were green. :thumbsup:
